lines.en: I scamper through the village
My blue loincloth flaps about

lines.zh: 我跟在别的哥布林后面
lines.en: I follow the bigger goblins
My steps come short and scattered
I squeeze between the barrels
I run around the mushroom racks
I kick dust off the dirt road
I chase a chicken a little way
I push into a knot of goblins
I squeeze through a door gap
I hop along happily
I trot without stopping
I scramble over the woodpile
I trot along the wall base
I duck into a broken shed
I push through hanging cloth
I circle the chicken coop
I crouch and scratch my ear

lines.zh: 我看看这个又看看那个
lines.en: I look at this, then that
I tug my loincloth straight
I gnaw a bit of root

lines.zh: 我抬头看比我高的哥布林
lines.en: I look up at the taller goblins
I sit on a barrel and swing my legs
I sniff my own hand
I scuff the dirt with a foot
I am glancing all about
I keep shifting my seat
I tuck my hands in my loincloth
I wait for someone to give me something

lines.zh: 我对着桶里的水照了照
lines.en: I look at myself in the barrel water
I put an ear to the boards
I draw circles in the dirt
I clutch my blue loincloth.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手有没有吃的
lines.en: I check your hands for food
My eyes go wide

lines.zh: 我朝旁边的人喊了一声
lines.en: I call out to the one beside me
Do not step on me
I show my two small fangs
I tug at your sleeve
You smell strange
I point at my own mouth

lines.zh: 我的蓝腰布蹭了一身泥。
lines.en: My blue loincloth is smeared with mud.
I hide behind the barrel
I whine twice
That hurt a lot
I hold my arm and run
My loincloth is dirty
I crouch and keep still
My legs shake, but I get up again.
I turn and bolt
Food! You have food
Can I have a piece
My hand is already out
The others are watching too
This piece is mine first
I hug the piece and will not let go
Give me a bit more
I shove it in and chew
Do not share it with them
I eat as I run off
I hold my hands up high
I hop twice in front of you
I watch the others’ hands
I tug the hem of your coat
I hop up to reach your hand
I open my mouth first
You knocked me over
My loincloth snagged
I get up and bump into you again
The others are laughing
I hold my nose and stand
I am a little sturdier than I look
I duck behind a barrel
I stick my tongue out at you
I hit a barrel and bounce back
I hunch my shoulders and back off
There are bigger ones in the village
I do not understand such things
I only want to eat first
They are all laughing at me
I hide in the back
Ask me when I am taller
I look at the others and duck my head
I bolt away
I tuck it into my loincloth

lines.zh: 我捡起掉在地上的一枚币
lines.en: I pick up a fallen coin

lines.zh: 我咬了一下看是不是真的
lines.en: I bite it to see if it is real
I will take this home
I find a chicken feather
I tuck it by my ear
I run off with it
I pick up another one
Then I will follow you
What do you want me to do
I run faster than they do
I scratch my shin
I come stand by your feet
I can do that job
I will come along with you
Let me try it first, then
My legs are warm from running
How far am I to follow
I keep circling your feet
You take a step, I take one
I tug your coat hem
I watch to see if you will give
I look up and wait for you to speak
I trot along beside you
Other goblins are coming too
I look at your pocket
I copy the way you walk
I leap and bite your finger
I hammer you with small fists
I grab once and back off
I throw a stone at your knee

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子，蓝腰布也扯着。
lines.en: I bite your sleeve, blue loincloth dragging.
I hit while shouting
I shove at your leg
I butt into you
I hug your leg
I tap you with a stick

lines.zh: 木桶后面钻出一个小脑袋
lines.en: A small head pops out behind a barrel
I squeeze in through the door gap
My blue loincloth shows first

lines.zh: 一群哥布林里多了一个
lines.en: One more joins the goblin crowd
I come running up the dirt road

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看大个子们
lines.en: I look up at the bigger ones
I peek from behind the mushroom rack
I crawl out of the mushroom pile.
I come out of the shed
I still clutch something in my hand
Fire singes a small patch of me
I bounce once on landing

lines.zh: 我的蓝腰布吸满了水，拖我下去。
lines.en: My blue loincloth is soaked and drags me down.
The blast throws me behind a barrel

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的耳朵，血是热的。
lines.en: The arrow grazed my ear; the blood is hot.
Magic flashes and I go numb
Nobody fed me all day
The thunder makes me cower
